stories.title: Frontier AI competition accelerates
stories.summary: Major model releases are pushing competition toward agents, coding and enterprise workflows.
stories.meaning: More capable agents can increase inference and tool use, potentially expanding cloud consumption even as unit costs fall.

stories.title: Gulf tensions keep energy risk central
stories.summary: Shipping and energy risks keep geopolitics tightly linked to the inflation outlook.
stories.meaning: Higher oil can lift inflation expectations, push yields higher and weigh on long-duration assets.

stories.title: Markets balance growth against tighter-policy risk
stories.summary: Risk assets are being pulled between resilient growth and concern that inflation could keep policy restrictive.
stories.meaning: A hawkish rates repricing can pressure long-duration equities and crypto despite solid growth.

stories.title: Social platforms turn engagement surfaces into content surfaces
stories.summary: New interaction formats are making comments, Shorts and creator tools more important for distribution.
stories.meaning: Creators increasingly need to design for participation, retention and downstream engagement.
